rules.statement: The requirement of premises by a landlord is reasonable when considering the impact on both the landlord and tenant, as well as other relevant factors.
rules.supporting_quote: "Furthermore, as I have said, there is nothing in the section to suggest that this one factor alone should be considered. I do not even think that to consider the requirement of the premises from the landlord's point of view exclusively would be any more reasonable than to consider it from the tenant's point of view exclusively."
